extracted.intended_audience: current and prospective grantees, philanthropic partners, and funders interested in ClimateWorks' programs and grantmaking practices
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational standards and program focus areas describing ClimateWorks' grantmaking priorities, how they work with partners, and the commitments they make to grantees about relationships, communications, and funding practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptation & Resilience
rubrics_metrics.description: Adapting to climate impacts and building resilience amid a rapidly changing environment is no longer optional. It is essential to save lives and secure a stable, prosperous future.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aviation
rubrics_metrics.description: While aviation emissions are projected to grow in the next few decades, there are opportunities now to lower emissions by shifting to sustainable aviation fuels and reducing demand.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooling
rubrics_metrics.description: The cooling sector requires transformative changes to sustainably provide people with access to the cooling they need in a rapidly warming world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carbon Dioxide Removal
rubrics_metrics.description: Along with reducing future greenhouse gas emissions, we must also remove existing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere to mitigate climate change and meet global climate goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food & Agriculture
rubrics_metrics.description: By reducing food waste and using smarter farming methods, we can cut emissions, nourish healthy communities, and strengthen economies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forests & Land Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Forests act as Earth’s lungs, absorbing CO2. Land use choices, like reducing deforestation, can help mitigate climate change by protecting these vital carbon stores.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry
rubrics_metrics.description: The industrial sector is a major source of climate pollution. Decarbonization is crucial to meeting global climate goals and creating a healthier planet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Just Transition
rubrics_metrics.description: The transition to a low-carbon economy can only be swift and effective with the meaningful participation of communities impacted by the transition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime Shipping
rubrics_metrics.description: Local communities, NGOs, policymakers, and businesses are transforming the maritime shipping sector toward a carbon-free future.

rubrics_metrics.name: Power
rubrics_metrics.description: Ditching dirty fuels for renewable power reduces climate pollution, supports communities and economies, and paves the way for a cleaner, healthier future.

rubrics_metrics.name: Road Transportation
rubrics_metrics.description: Decarbonizing road transportation cuts climate pollution, improves air quality and public health, and is crucial for a thriving planet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable Finance
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainable finance redirects investments to fight climate change and makes investing in climate solutions more attractive and accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to our program leadership, we also provide funders with expertise to help design and implement grantmaking strategies that drive climate progress. By harnessing our global networks and philanthropic infrastructure, we also help funders and other partners in the climate philanthropy ecosystem to connect, share knowledge, and advance solutions together.

rubrics_metrics.name: China and India (geographic support)
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with partner foundations in the U.S. and Europe that are interested in China and India by providing timely and context-specific advice, analysis, and recommendations on innovative climate solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We help develop joint ideas and strategies, identify local partners, and actively engage with governments, the local philanthropic community, and civil society to share international experiences and best practices in mitigating climate change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong and positive relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: ClimateWorks staff cultivate open communications with grantees and foster relationships where grantees feel that they are in partnership with ClimateWorks and safe to discuss challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectation that staff build trust and open dialogue; relationships framed as partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees have clarity on relevant ClimateWorks staff to contact and receive proactive communication and timely responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grantees can expect acknowledgment of any messages within 72 working hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees receive requirements related to their grant and relevant updates throughout the grant process. Grantees are also given context for requests, and ClimateWorks is transparent about how we use grantee materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide context for requests and transparency about use of materials so grantees understand obligations and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees feel respected and treated as essential partners. They understand ClimateWorks’ intentions and trust that staff are upfront and honest with them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ClimateWorks staff will adapt in response to continuous learning; emphasis on trust and candor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding of true costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Grantees feel assured that ClimateWorks applies a consistent approach to covering the full costs of work undertaken in partnership with ClimateWorks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ClimateWorks staff aim to understand and eliminate additional financial burdens that arise from receiving a ClimateWorks grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value beyond the grant
rubrics_metrics.description: We hope that grantees benefit from their relationship with ClimateWorks beyond receiving financial support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When possible, grantees will also have access to non-monetary support, such as activities and relationships that ClimateWorks facilitates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Living up to these commitments / Feedback and continuous improvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Delivering on our commitments to grantees is an ongoing effort. ClimateWorks continually evaluates and updates our policies and practices based on ongoing learning and feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ClimateWorks reviews insights from its Grantee Perception Report (2024) and welcomes feedback via direct conversations, GranteeFeedback@ClimateWorks.org, and an anonymous form.
